data.title: Bitcoin, Ethereum, Dogecoin Fall; XRP Gains Ahead of Key Inflation Data: Analyst Notes 'Another Strong Bullish Signal' for BTC
data.description: Leading cryptocurrencies fell on Tuesday as traders awaited key inflation data for clues on the Federal Reserve’s interest rate policy.Crypto Market Sees Selling PressureBitcoin slid below $78,000 as trading volume jumped nearly 50% in the last 24 hours.
